skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator for two unlike denominators and convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Same-Denominator Numerator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Whole-Number Part Handling
skills.definition: Separate and subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers, including treating a bare whole number or fraction as a mixed number with a zero part, before combining with the fraction result.

skills.name: Borrow/Regroup for Negative Fraction Difference
skills.definition: When the fraction-part subtraction is negative, borrow one whole unit (as denominator/denominator) from the whole-part result and redo the fraction subtraction, repeating if still negative.

skills.name: Simplify to Lowest Terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Normalize Improper Fractional Part in Mixed Number
skills.definition: Correctly interpret and regroup a mixed number whose written fraction part is itself improper (numerator ≥ denominator) so its true value is used in subtraction.
